            hidden,
            summary,
            square_summary,

        ) = state
        outputs, hidden = self.gru(
            self.input_norm(frames), hidden.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()

            frames.shape[1], device=frames.device

                hidden[:, 0, :],
                running_max,

            summary,
            square_summary,
            running_max,
            count,
            bin_summary,

        safe_count = count.clamp_min(1.0)
        mean = summary / safe_count
        deviation = (
            square_summary / safe_count - mean.square()

        safe_bin_count = bin_count.clamp_min(1.0)
        bin_mean = bin_summary / safe_bin_count
        bin_deviation = (
            bin_square_summary / safe_bin_count - bin_mean.square()

                running_max,
                deviation,
                bin_mean.flatten(start_dim=1),
                bin_deviation.flatten(start_dim=1),
            ),
            dim=1,
